items.title: Bashar regrets Rana's absence from Australia tour despite being 'extra cautious'
items.summary: Bangladesh chief selector said Rana's side strain was "unfortunate", and that it's "hard to keep fast bowlers free of injuries"

items.title: Bangladesh excited for next tours as Joty sets lofty goal
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain is looking forward to the challenge and wants her teammates to rise to the occasion against three of the biggest teams in women's cricket.

items.title: Injury-hit Tigers throw a mixed bag for Australia opener
items.summary: Soumya is perhaps the most intriguing inclusion, although his domestic form makes a compelling case for his return, either as an opener or in the middle order.

items.title: Bangladesh missed World Cup due to 'political issues': Miraz
items.summary: Bangladesh ODI captain Mehidy Hasan Miraz believes the Tigers were deprived of the opportunity to play in a World Cup because of "political issues", saying it was unfortunate that the players missed out on the marquee event.

items.title: Bangladesh recall Soumya Sarkar for first Test against Australia
items.summary: Jaker Ali and Musfik Hasan were also picked, while Mehidy Hasan Miraz and Taskin Ahmed returned after being rested for the Zimbabwe Test

items.title: Soumya, Jaker return for first Australia Test
items.summary: Opener Mahmudul Hasan Joy was left out after a run of poor starts at the top of the order.

items.title: Nahid Rana ruled out of Test series against Australia
items.summary: Shoriful Islam and Litton Das will also miss the first Test but could be available for the second after rehabilitation

items.title: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka get direct entry into Asian Games knockouts
items.summary: The men's competition will have ten teams and the women's competition will have eight sides and will start with the quarter-finals

items.title: Konstas, Kellaway, Patterson named in CA XI to face Bangladesh
items.summary: Rocchiccioli, Philippe, Doran also included for the three-day tour game
